changelogs.text: Added more cosmetics to the cape collection
Added Nythera+, a presence board to see who's online and what they're wearing
Cosmetics are now tied to your Nythera Launcher account instead of just your Minecraft account
Added a custom color option for the Crosshair mod
Fixed the Crosshair mod turning translucent when a custom color was selected
Updated the mod menu logo to match the main menu icon
General bug fixes and stability improvements
